hooks.command: cat >/dev/null || true; if command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1; then CRG=code-review-graph; elif command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1; then CRG='uvx code-review-graph'; else exit 0; fi; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && $CRG update --skip-flows --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || true

cat >/dev/null || true; if command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1; then CRG=code-review-graph; elif command -v uvx >/dev/null 2>&1; then CRG='uvx code-review-graph'; else echo 'code-review-graph unavailable, skipping'; exit 0; fi; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && $CRG status --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'
